parameters.command:
=source /opt/ansible/patch-db.env && \
sudo rm -f /opt/ansible/reports/json/*.json && \
sudo -E ansible-playbook \
/opt/ansible/playbooks/patch_assessment_centos.yml \
-i /opt/ansible/inventory/dynamic_hosts.py \
--extra-vars '{{ JSON.stringify({ target_hosts: $json.hosts.map(h => h.hostname), os_family: "centos" }) }}' && \
echo "===PATCH_REPORT_START===" && \
sudo cat /opt/ansible/reports/json/centos_assessment_*.json && \
echo "===PATCH_REPORT_END==="

nodes.name: Run CentOS Assessment (172.16.3.64)
nodes.notes: Wrapper playbook: gathers os-release/uname, yum/dnf check-update, security/critical package counts, reboot-required. Never runs 'yum update -y'.

parameters.jsCode:
// Build the HTML body for the monthly report email. const s = items[0].json; const rowsHtml = s.servers.map(r => ` ${r.hostname || ''} ${r.os || ''} ${r.os_version || ''} ${r.status} ${r.available_updates ?? '-'} ${r.security_updates ?? '-'} ${r.critical_updates ?? '-'} ${r.reboot_required ? 'Yes' : 'No'} `).join(''); const html = `

Linux Monthly Patch Management Report - ${s.patch_cycle}

Overall Compliance: ${s.patch_compliance_percentage}%

Total Servers${s.total_servers}
Compliant${s.compliant_servers}
Patch Available${s.patch_available}
Security Patch Available${s.security_updates_available}
Critical Patch Available${s.critical_updates_available}
Reboot Required${s.reboot_required}
Unreachable${s.unreachable_servers}
Repository Errors${s.repository_errors}
Inventory Mismatches${s.inventory_mismatches}
Unsupported OS${s.unsupported_os}
${rowsHtml}
HostnameOSStatusAvailableSecurityCriticalReboot Req.
`; return [{ json: { ...s, html_report: html, email_subject: `Linux Monthly Patch Status - ${s.patch_cycle} - ${s.patch_compliance_percentage}% Compliance` } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO linux_patch.patch_cycle
(
    month,
    year,
    total_servers,
    compliant_servers,
    patch_available,
    security_updates_available,
    critical_updates,
    patched,
    failed,
    unreachable,
    repository_errors,
    compliance_percentage
)
VALUES
(
    '{{$json.patch_cycle.split(' ')[0]}}',
    {{$json.patch_cycle.split(' ')[1]}},
    {{$json.total_servers}},
    {{$json.compliant_servers}},
    {{$json.patch_available}},
    {{$json.security_updates_available || 0}},
    {{$json.critical_updates_available || 0}},
    {{$json.patched || 0}},
    {{$json.failed || 0}},
    {{$json.unreachable_servers || 0}},
    {{$json.repository_errors || 0}},
    {{$json.patch_compliance_percentage || 0}}
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    total_servers = VALUES(total_servers),
    compliant_servers = VALUES(compliant_servers),
    patch_available = VALUES(patch_available),
    security_updates_available = VALUES(security_updates_available),
    critical_updates = VALUES(critical_updates),
    patched = VALUES(patched),
    failed = VALUES(failed),
    unreachable = VALUES(unreachable),
    repository_errors = VALUES(repository_errors),
    compliance_percentage = VALUES(compliance_percentage);
